_note: Reviewer routing for [GP-Bot] PRs, consumed by .github/workflows/gpbot-pr-triage.yml.
Bot PRs arrive without a human owner. This file says which rotation owns the ticket and how to reach that rotation's holder on GitHub; it does not say who the holder is.
Editing it is a normal reviewable PR — that is the point of it being here rather than in workflow YAML.

A SIBLING of the file by the same name in thegoodparty/omni, not a copy of it. The workflow reads the roster from its own repo, and the two repos have different owners: omni's bot PRs belong to the @serve-bugs and @win-bugs engineering rotations, and a marketing-site PR belongs to whoever owns the marketing site. Only githubLogins is genuinely duplicated, and a missing entry there costs one un-requested review rather than a wrong one.

There is deliberately no reviewer pool. The bug rotations carry exactly one person at a time, so the Slack group already IS the answer to 'who looks at this': the workflow reads the current holder from usergroups.users.list when the PR opens, and a handoff needs no commit here.
